subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Greater, Less, or Equal
objective: Compare whole numbers by place value.
introduction: Compare digits from the greatest place to the ones place. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: To look at how things are the same or different.
A symbol or word that tells how many.
What a digit is worth by its position.

items.prompt: Which statement best matches “Greater, Less, or Equal”?

options.text: Compare digits from the greatest place to the ones place.

items.explanation: The correct response is “Compare digits from the greatest place to the ones place.” because it matches what we learned: Compare digits from the greatest place to the ones place.
